versions.changelog:
Initial release of the cn-web-screenshot skill.

- Enables automatic webpage screenshots by URL with support for full-page, viewport, mobile/tablet view, and delay for dynamic content.
- Saves images in PNG format with customizable output paths.
- Recognizes user intents such as “截取网页”, “网页截图”, and automates the screenshot process.
- Built on Playwright and works with Chromium browser.
- Designed for archiving, visual testing, preview generation, and inspecting page rendering.
